page.content:
It is a large pink and white rabbit. Catching the rabbit will give special items, such as Mega Mushrooms. If the Big Rabbit is glowing green, it is holding a Green Power Star.

page.overview:
Who is Big Rabbit?

It is a large pink and white rabbit. Catching the rabbit will give special items, such as Mega Mushrooms. If the Big Rabbit is glowing green, it is holding a Green Power Star.
